tool_args.rationale: The acquired high-gradient measurements reveal the predicted supercritical collapse. Fit the recalled threshold-avalanche law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition or Cobb–Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient observations fall sharply to negative values, consistent with a gradient-triggered avalanche rather than these positive smooth curves.
Eight observations, including three above the threshold, constrain the five parameters of the stated avalanche mechanism; an additional trajectory is not presently needed.
It does not discriminate the target mechanism.
